channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Two killed, refinery on fire in Russia’s Krasnodar after drone attack
item.description: Ukraine hits Russia's Afipsky oil refinery and gas plant in latest attacks targeting energy infrastructure.

item.title: UK to back Ukraine with missile blueprints amid Russia-Ukraine strikes
item.description: UK PM Andy Burnham visited Kyiv on his first foreign trip, pledging to give cruise missile designs to Ukraine.

item.title: How the US sanctions on Iran impact China

item.title: Can Pakistan’s Asim Munir convince Iran military chiefs to return to talks?
item.description: Pakistan says progress was made in Tehran, but Iran’s security establishment remains wary of Washington.

item.title: Kremlin adviser warns UK drone factories could face attacks
item.description: Russia says UK decision to share missile blueprints with Ukraine is evidence of direct military involvement in the war.

item.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
item.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
